sentences.en: The surgeon persuaded me to undergo an organ transplant operation.
sentences.zh: 那名外科医生说服我接受器官移植手术。

sentences.en: He had to undergo an operation immediately after his fall.
sentences.zh: 他摔倒后不得不立即进行手术治疗。

sentences.en: Stars undergo nuclear reactions that burn hydrogen in their cores.
sentences.zh: 恒星经历核反应，其核心中的氢被燃烧。

senses.zh: 经历，经受；接受（治疗等）；经历（变化等）
